questions.question:

• As per the context of the sentence, **humans have an inclination towards a particular activity.**
 
• In the current scenario, the verb 'tendency' is the correct choice in the given blank.

 

Correct Sentence__: *Humans have a natural tendency to coordinate their movements with music.*

questions.question:
**Choose the appropriate form of the tense for the given sentence.**

Leadership ________ a rational approach to achieve success in any task.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is - **requires**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The simple present tense is used when an action is happening right now, to state or ask about things in general, or when it happens regularly or unceasingly.
 
• The structure is given below:
 
 
• Subject + V1 + object. (Active Voice)
 
• Object + is/am/are + V3 + subject. (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The verb will take 's/es' in the active voice if the given noun/pronoun (3rd person) is singular.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *​He plays badminton daily. *(Active Voice)
 
• *Badminton is played by him daily. *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• As '**Leadership**' is a **singular noun**, 'requires' will be used in the blank.

Correct Sentence__: *Leadership requires a rational approach to achieve success in any task.*

* *​​​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Certain verbs used only in the simple present tense are given below:

 
 
• ​See, think, know, possess, like, want, desire, hate, seem, imagine, etc.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *​My brother is owning a car. (incorrect)*
 
• *​My brother owns a car. (correct)*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• It literally meant to **work **by the side of a **candle**.
